sceneDescription: On a supermarket checkout belt, a bright red plastic fuel canister sits inside a wire miniature shopping cart, as if it's the weekly groceries. Next to it: an ornate gold pocket watch, a crumpled shipping box with a subtle Practical Ecommerce sticker, a tangled bunch of keys, and a stack of toy-sized cardboard boxes. Peeking from the shopping cart, a tiny branded shopping bag shows a corner of the Modern Retail logo, while a jewelry tag with the Jeweller logo dangles off the pocket watch. Everything sits under soft, natural grocery store lighting, making the absurdity of the combination pop yet remain believable.
